script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.
A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Mary has already reached the tomb when she sees the stone. The text does not say how she traveled the rest of the way there.
The sound-effects joke makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
The text does not say that not knowing where the body is was exactly why Mary came running.
The text does not say Mary is out of breath. It also has her explain the problem, rather than being unable to explain it.
The rolled-up cloth does not establish that someone was not in a hurry. The text leaves that open.
The descriptions of Moses as Israel's leader and Elijah as a prophet need references; Matthew 17:3 does not state those roles.
The garden is a detail from outside this passage and needs a reference. The line also suggests a reason Mary thought Jesus was the gardener that the text does not give.
The explanation gives away what Jesus says to the disciples in the next part of the story.
Mary asked Jesus, whom she thought was the gardener. The explanation calls Him the gardener as though that were who He was.
